title: De syv føllene
world: Old rural Norway, long ago. The poor family lives in a tiny, crooked turf-roofed hut deep in a spruce forest. The seven foals are glossy chestnut foals with flaxen manes and tails, all alike except the youngest and smallest, who has a white star on his forehead. As princes they are seven brothers from about ten to twenty, with their sister's strawberry-blonde hair and shining white-and-gold clothes. The old woman's rock cleft is a small, shallow cave at the foot of a grey cliff beside a forest path, with a little spinning wheel inside. A big white birch stump in a clearing hides a door to a small secret room with rough wooden walls, a hearth, a shelf with a small brown jar and a big, rusty sword on a hook. The church is small and black-tarred with a tall tower, beyond a long wooden bridge over a river.
palette: Midsummer: long, pale-gold days, a low sun that hardly sets and bright, pale nights under a lilac sky; violet mountains on the horizon, purple heather, birch woods and dewy grass, with long golden shadows in the evenings. The wedding glows with warm candlelight and golden light spilling from open doors.

cast.name: Askeladden
cast.description: Den yngste broren, rolig og nysgjerrig, som holder ut når andre gir opp og bruker både mot og omtanke.
cast.look: A sturdy, broad-shouldered boy of about fifteen with full, round, sun-browned cheeks, a short straight nose, calm green eyes, a steady, determined smile and thick sandy-brown hair tied at the back of his neck with a leather cord. He wears a patched rust-orange wool jacket with bone buttons over a cream shirt, dark-green trousers tucked into sturdy black boots, and a small brown leather knapsack on his back.
cast.portrait: Background: purple heather and violet mountains in midsummer light.

cast.name: Kongen
cast.description: En streng, men rettferdig konge som setter en prøve og belønner den som viser ekte ansvar.
cast.look: A lean, severe king of about sixty, tall and straight-backed, with a long, bony face, stern frown lines, sharp, narrow hazel eyes under bushy black eyebrows and a short, neatly trimmed grey beard. He wears a long dark-red robe with a grey fur collar, a thick gold chain across his chest, a small, spiky gold crown and pointed black shoes.
cast.portrait: Background: the front steps of the Royal Farm.

cast.name: Den gamle kona i bergskorten
cast.description: En gammel kone som sitter og spinner i bergskorten og lokker slitne gjetergutter til å sove bort hele dagen med hodet i fanget hennes.
cast.look: A tiny, hunched old woman, no taller than a ten-year-old child, with a small, wrinkled face, a very long, pointed nose that nearly touches her chin, little twinkling black eyes, a sweet, sly smile and wisps of white hair. She is wrapped in many layered shawls of faded blue, brown, plum and grey, one on top of the other, over a long dark skirt, with worn felt slippers on her feet.
cast.portrait: Background: her grey rock cleft beside the forest path.

cast.name: Det yngste føllet (en av de sju prinsene)
cast.description: Det klokeste og mest hjelpsomme føllet, som lar Askeladden ri og leder ham til stedet der hemmeligheten avsløres.
cast.look: A small, slender chestnut foal, the youngest and smallest of seven, with long, knobbly legs, a glossy red-brown coat, a short flaxen mane that stands up like a brush, a long flaxen tail, soft pointed ears, big dark clever eyes with long lashes and a neat white star on his forehead.
cast.portrait: Background: a heather-covered hillside at midsummer.

cast.name: Den yngste prinsen
cast.description: Det yngste føllet slik han egentlig er: den yngste av de sju prinsene og lillebror til prinsessa, som smiler med hele ansiktet når trolldommen er borte.
cast.look: A small, quick boy prince of about ten, the youngest of seven brothers, with a round, freckled face, big dark eyes, a huge beaming smile and tousled strawberry-blonde hair. He wears shining white-and-gold clothes: a white tunic embroidered with gold, a short white cape with gold trim, white breeches and soft white boots, with a small white star embroidered on the chest of his tunic.
cast.portrait: Background: the stable in warm golden light.

cast.name: Prinsessa
cast.description: Kongens datter, varm og glad, som ser Askeladdens mot og snillhet når prøven er over.
cast.look: A cheerful princess of about sixteen with a round, freckled face, warm brown eyes, a wide, happy smile and a mass of bouncy strawberry-blonde curls falling past her shoulders, with a small gold crown set with a green stone. She wears a long pale-green dress with white lace at the collar and cuffs, a gold-embroidered belt and pale-green slippers.
cast.portrait: Background: the Royal Farm in the pale midsummer night.

cast.name: Den eldste broren
cast.description: Askeladdens eldste bror, som vil ut og tjene penger, men sovner hos den gamle kona i bergskorten og må måke møkk i sju dager.
cast.look: A tall, gawky lad of about nineteen with a long, bony face, a big chin, heavy-lidded sleepy eyes, a long nose, a lazy, lopsided grin and thick, wavy dark-blond hair that sticks up at the back. He wears a red-and-white checked shirt with rolled sleeves, baggy brown trousers held up by a single braces strap and a wide, frayed straw hat, and he goes barefoot.
cast.portrait: Background: the tiny hut in the spruce forest.

places.name: the Royal Farm
places.look: A grand old royal farm of ox-blood-red log buildings with white-trimmed windows, grass-covered turf roofs and carved dragon-head gables, set around a wide, sandy yard. The main hall has broad wooden front steps with carved railings up to a big double door. Across the yard stands a long red log stable with a wide door, and a split-rail paddock fence runs along the birch trees, with violet mountains far behind.

cover.prompt: On a heather-covered hillside in the pale light of a midsummer night, Askeladden stands with one arm around the neck of the Youngest Foal, both looking out at the viewer, the foal's white star bright on his forehead. Behind them the six other chestnut foals graze and frisk in the purple heather, and a low golden sun glows over violet mountains.
cover.caption: Askeladden og det yngste føllet, det med den hvite stjerna i panna.
cover.alt: Askeladden står i lyngen med armen rundt halsen på et lite, rødbrunt føll med en hvit stjerne i panna. Bak dem beiter seks andre føll, og langt borte ligger fiolette fjell.

illustrations.anchor: «Da kan du gjete de sju føllene mine», sa kongen.
illustrations.prompt: Evening at the Royal Farm, in long golden light. The King stands at the top of the front steps, stern and straight, pointing a long finger at the paddock, where seven chestnut foals frisk about, the smallest of them the Youngest Foal. At the foot of the steps the Eldest Brother stands with his straw hat in his hands and a lazy, confident grin, as if it will be easy. A wide view, with violet mountains far behind.
illustrations.caption: «Da kan du gjete de sju føllene mine», sier kongen.
illustrations.alt: Kongen står øverst på trappa på kongsgården og peker mot sju føll i en innhegning. Nedenfor trappa står den eldste broren med hatten i hånda og smiler selvsikkert.

illustrations.prompt: At the old woman's rock cleft, a small cave at the foot of a grey cliff, the Old Woman sits at her little spinning wheel, spinning with one hand and scratching the hair of the Eldest Brother with the other. He lies stretched out with his head in her lap, fast asleep with his mouth open, his straw hat fallen off. Far away between the birch trees, the seven foals flash past like bright streaks. Warm midday light and soft shadows.
illustrations.caption: Hun klør og spinner, og spinner og klør. Og gutten sover.
illustrations.alt: Den eldste broren sover med hodet i fanget til en bitte liten, gammel kone i ei hule i berget. Hun spinner og klør ham i håret, mens føllene suser forbi langt borte.

illustrations.prompt: Evening at the Royal Farm: on the front steps the King holds up a tuft of green moss between two fingers and glares at it, one bushy eyebrow raised sky-high. Below him the Eldest Brother holds out a bottle of water with a hopeful, sheepish smile, his clothes rumpled and bits of moss stuck in his hair. Long evening shadows stretch across the sandy yard. A medium view from below the steps.
illustrations.caption: «Mose?» sier kongen. «Tror du føllene mine er reinsdyr?»
illustrations.alt: Kongen står på trappa og holder opp en dott mose med det ene øyebrynet høyt oppe i panna. Nedenfor står den eldste broren med en flaske vann og smiler forsiktig.

illustrations.anchor: Brødrene lo så de holdt på å falle av benken.
illustrations.prompt: Inside the tiny, crooked hut in the forest, Askeladden rises from the ashes by the fireplace, a puff of grey ash drifting off his jacket, with a calm, determined face. On the bench along the wall, the Eldest Brother and the middle brother, a short, stocky lad with a round pink face and short, spiky black hair, laugh so hard that they nearly tip off the bench, clutching their bellies, one of them with his legs kicking in the air. Daylight through a tiny window.
illustrations.caption: «Du?» Brødrene ler så de nesten faller av benken.
illustrations.alt: Askeladden reiser seg fra aska ved peisen i den lille hytta. På benken ved veggen ler de to brødrene hans så de nesten faller ned.

illustrations.anchor: Neste morgen, da hanen gol, slapp stallmesteren ut føllene.
illustrations.prompt: Early morning in the birch forest: the seven chestnut foals gallop in a long line through the purple heather, and behind the last and smallest one, the Youngest Foal, Askeladden flies straight out in the air, gripping its tail with both hands, stretched out like a kite on a string, his knapsack flapping. Leaves and dust whirl around him, and he grins with determination. Low morning sun slants between the trunks.
illustrations.caption: Askeladden holder fast i halen og flyr etter som en papirdrage på snor.
illustrations.alt: Sju føll galopperer gjennom lyngen. Askeladden holder seg fast i halen på det minste føllet og flyr etter som en papirdrage, mens løv og støv virvler rundt ham.

illustrations.anchor: Det eldste føllet dyttet til stubben.
illustrations.prompt: In a quiet forest clearing, the biggest of the seven foals, the eldest, pushes a huge white birch stump aside with its nose; the stump slides away with a creak and reveals a small wooden door in the ground where it stood. Askeladden sits on the back of the Youngest Foal, leaning forward with wide, curious eyes, and the other five foals stand around in a half circle. Pale midsummer light through the birches.
illustrations.caption: Knirk! Stubben glir til side, og der den sto, er det en dør.
illustrations.alt: Det eldste føllet dytter en diger, hvit bjørkestubbe til side med mulen, og under den er det en liten dør. Askeladden sitter på ryggen til det yngste føllet og gjør store øyne.

illustrations.anchor: Askeladden tok krukka ned fra hylla og drakk.
illustrations.prompt: In the small secret room with rough wooden walls, lit by the glow of the hearth, Askeladden holds the big, rusty sword straight up in one hand as easily as a toothbrush, its point towards the ceiling, and stares at it with a surprised, delighted grin. In his other hand he holds the small brown jar. The Youngest Foal stands beside him and nods approvingly. Below the empty hook on the wall is a little shelf.
illustrations.caption: Glugg, glugg, glugg! Nå løfter Askeladden sverdet like lett som en tannbørste.
illustrations.alt: I et lite, hemmelig rom med trevegger holder Askeladden et stort, rustent sverd i været med én hånd og en liten krukke i den andre. Det yngste føllet står ved siden av.

illustrations.anchor: Da føllene trampet inn på kirkegården, skjedde det noe rart.
illustrations.prompt: In the green churchyard in front of the small black church with its tall tower, seven princes stand where the seven foals were a moment ago, in white-and-gold clothes that glow with a soft light, sparkles still swirling around them. The smallest of them is the Youngest Prince, beaming. Askeladden stands just inside the gate with his mouth wide open in amazement. Birch trees, a low stone wall and a low golden sun.
illustrations.caption: Pels blir til klær, og hover blir til sko. Der står sju prinser!
illustrations.alt: Foran en liten, svart kirke står sju prinser i klær av hvitt og gull som lyser, og glitter virvler rundt dem. Askeladden står ved porten og måper.

illustrations.prompt: Dusk under a pale lilac sky: Askeladden whooshes past the old woman's rock cleft on the back of the Youngest Foal, with the six other foals racing ahead, a small round loaf and a bottle poking out of his knapsack. In the mouth of the little cave, the Old Woman has jumped up from her spinning wheel and shakes her fist after them, cross and comical, her shawls flapping. Leaves and dust whirl up in their wake.
illustrations.caption: «... dumme ... gutt ... GRRR!» roper den gamle kona.
illustrations.alt: Askeladden suser forbi hula i berget på ryggen til det yngste føllet, med brød og vin i skreppa. Den gamle kona har hoppet opp fra rokken og roper sint etter ham.

illustrations.prompt: In the yard of the Royal Farm in the pale, almost-dark midsummer night, Askeladden stands holding out a small round loaf of bread and a bottle of wine, with birch leaves stuck in his hair. The King, facing him, smiles for the first time, his stern face softening. On the front steps behind the King, the Princess smiles warmly at Askeladden. Lanterns glow by the door, and behind Askeladden the seven foals stand quietly, the Youngest Foal nuzzling his shoulder.
illustrations.caption: «Endelig en som har fulgt med!» Og prinsessa smiler, hun også.
illustrations.alt: Askeladden holder fram et lite brød og en flaske vin, med løv i håret. Kongen smiler for første gang, og prinsessa smiler fra trappa bak ham.

illustrations.anchor: Føllet skalv. Det glitret i pelsen.
illustrations.prompt: In the warm, quiet stable, golden light from the wedding party falls through the open door onto the straw. Where the eldest foal stood a moment ago, a tall young prince in shining white-and-gold clothes now stands, looking at his own hands in wonder, glitter still sparkling around him. Askeladden holds the big rusty sword lowered, its point resting in the straw, and grins. The six other foals, among them the Youngest Foal, watch with clever eyes.
illustrations.caption: Snipp! Det glitrer i pelsen, og der står en prins.
illustrations.alt: I stallen står en høy prins i klær av hvitt og gull der det eldste føllet sto. Askeladden holder sverdet ned mot halmen og smiler, og seks føll ser på.

illustrations.prompt: In the festive hall, bright with candles and birch branches, the King kisses Askeladden on the cheek and claps him on the back, while the Princess, with a wreath of white flowers in her curls, hugs the Youngest Prince. The six other princes in shining white-and-gold crowd around them, laughing. Behind them rises a huge wedding cake, taller than the King, and a dropped cake fork lies on the floor. Warm golden candlelight.
illustrations.caption: «Guttene mine!» roper kongen, og prinsessa klemmer brødrene sine, én etter én.
illustrations.alt: I festsalen kysser kongen Askeladden på kinnet, og prinsessa klemmer den yngste prinsen. Rundt dem ler de andre prinsene, og bak står ei kake som er høyere enn kongen.
